summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its consolidated financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 under Japanese GAAP. The filing includes ordinary income of ¥10,790,853 million, ordinary profit of ¥2,303,350 million, and profit attributable to owners of parent of ¥1,582,973 million. It also announces an ordinary general meeting of shareholders on June 26, 2026. There are no terms of a special situation transaction, no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. This is a routine earnings report and meeting notice, not a special-situation filing.
